arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
xl = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print('Sheets:', xl.sheet_names)
for sheet in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xl, sheet_name=sheet, header=None)
    print(f'\n--- Sheet: {sheet} ---')
    print(df.to_string())
"

which libreoffice soffice; python3 -c "
import shutil

"

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)
exp = df.iloc[10:22, [0, 1, 2]].copy()  # rows 11-22: expense line items (col A=category, B=item, C=amount)
exp.columns = ['Category', 'Item', 'Amount']

print(exp.to_string(index=False))
print()
print('Total Expenses: ', exp['Amount'].sum())
print()
by_cat = exp.groupby('Category')['Amount'].sum()
print(by_cat.to_string())
"
